evals.prompt: Show me which providers have H100s available right now.
expectations: Shows provider names and prices in a table
Does not invent prices or availability

evals.prompt: Add a spot A100 node to my knr-ops repo at ~/knr-ops for under $2/hr.
expectations: Uses terradev k8s node add with --spot and --max-price flags
Explains the node ready step if IP is not immediately available

evals.prompt: Remove the GPU node gpu-worker-01 from my GitOps repo.
expectations: Uses terradev k8s node rm gpu-worker-01
Instructs user to push the repo after removal
Mentions that the underlying instance will be terminated

evals.prompt: How do I watch Flux pick up the new node I just committed?
expectations: Mentions pushing the repo first if not done
